findings.issue: A clean checkout has no dist/cli.js, so npm test and quality:gate silently skip 11 existing runtime assertions on every platform, including Windows. This omits backup integrity, credential rejection, HTTP authorization and concurrent-writer checks while reporting success. Build the runtime before running tests and retain unconditional assertions.

The repair fixture mocks inference via runProcess but leaves nativeAdmission's RPC boundary live. On a logged-in host with exhausted quota, five existing full-suite assertions fail before the fake CLI runs; results therefore depend on the host account rather than fixture state. Isolate native metadata using the existing unknownAdmission fixture pattern and verify no live account RPC occurs.

summary: Fixed two medium findings with regressions proven red before each fix: clean-checkout test runs now build and retain all 11 runtime assertions, and repair fixtures no longer consult live account metadata. Typecheck, the 78-test focused set, both full regression rounds, and all 13 retained CJS regressions pass locally. New-commit Node 22 CI, Linux and fixed 50-persona acceptance remain unverified.
